verses.1: This is a record of Adam’s creation. On the day that God created man, He made him in His own image.
verses.2: He remembered the male and female, and he blessed them. On the day of their creation, he named them “Man”.
verses.3: And man lived for thirty years, and then he gave birth to a son. He named his son Seth.
verses.4: And there were days when people lived after they had given birth to their children. They would then have sons and daughters.
verses.5: And every day, every human being lived for forty years and thirty-three years before they died.
verses.6: And he lived for five years and a month, and then he gave birth to a son.
verses.7: And he lived after his father had died for seventy years and sixty months. He then had sons and daughters.
verses.8: And he lived for twenty-two years and nine hundred and fifty days. Then he died.
verses.9: And the man lived for ninety years, and he had twelve sons.
verses.10: And the man lived after his birth for fifteen years and six months. During that time, he had sons and daughters.
verses.11: And every man lived for five years and forty-nine years, before he died.
verses.12: And he lived for seventy years, during which time he had twelve sons.
verses.13: And he lived for forty years after his birth. He had sons and daughters.
verses.14: And he lived for twelve years and fifty-nine hundred days. Then he died.
verses.15: And Mahalalel lived for fifty years and sixty years, and he had sons.
verses.16: And Mahalalel lived after his father had lived for thirty years and nine months. He had sons and daughters.
verses.17: And he lived for fifty-five years, seventy years, and sixty years. Then he died.
verses.18: And he lived for two hundred and sixty years. After that, he had another son.
verses.19: And Yered lived after his father had died. He had many children and grandchildren.
verses.20: And he lived for two hundred and sixty years. Then he died.
verses.21: And Hanok lived for fifty-six years. During those years, he had two sons: Metushalach and another son.
verses.22: And he walked in God’s ways, after his birth. He lived for three years, and then he had sons and daughters.
verses.23: And it was five and sixty years from the day of his exile.
verses.24: And he walked in the ways of God, and he was not like those who took God away from them.
verses.25: And Methuselah lived for seventy-two years. Then he had a son named Lamec.
verses.26: And Matusalem lived after his descendants. He had two sons and two daughters. He also had children of his own.
verses.27: And he lived for forty years, fifty years, and nine hundred years in total. Then he died.
verses.28: And he lived for two years and two months. Then he died. And he had a son.
verses.29: And he called out his name, saying, “May this be a source of comfort for us from our sins and from the troubles that afflict our hands on this land, which the LORD has made us possess.”
verses.30: And he lived to be fifty-five years old after having born Noah. He also had seven sons and three daughters.
verses.31: And it was seven and seventy years, plus seven thousand years, before he died.
verses.32: And Noah was born at the age of five hundred years. Noah also had sons and daughters.
